name: prd-subagentstop-block-once-claude
doc: TARGET behavior once Lots A/B ship (prd-design.md §2.4, not implemented yet — Lot D only). backend-expert's SubagentStop fires while its own sub-task (jwt-validation) is still 'assigned' in the task PRD and NOT reported 'done' in its own agent report (no prd/agents/backend-expert-prd.json on disk at all here) -> incompleteSubTasks finds a violation -> block-once: first SubagentStop for this session+agent -> blockResponse (Claude/Codex shape {"decision":"block","reason":...}, adapters/claude/index.ts:40); an IDENTICAL replay of the same SubagentStop for the same session -> already-blocked-once -> empty stdout (let it stop). RED TODAY BY DESIGN: verified live 2026-09-02 against `bun src/cli/bin.ts hook claude-code core` with this exact setup (FUSE_PRD=1, router+task-PRD present, no agent report) — the CURRENT SubagentStop dispatch (harvestSubagentTrack + trackAgentMemory, lifecycle/dispatch.ts's existing SubagentStop case) has no PRD awareness at all and returns `{"message":"Agent backend-expert completed (no code changes)"}` on BOTH calls (no `decision` key ever, so step 1 fails; not empty either, so step 2 fails too) — a real response is emitted today, just not the PRD gate's.

steps.doc: First SubagentStop for backend-expert, jwt-validation still incomplete -> expected block.
Identical replay, same session_id+agent -> already blocked once -> pass through silently (empty stdout), never a permanent stop-loop.
